style: gentle educational storybook identity and communication scenes for young Chinese learners

items.label: Exchange phone number
items.sentenceHanzi: 安安告诉思思家里的电话号码。
items.sentencePinyin: An an gao su Si si jia li de dian hua hao ma.
items.sentenceEnglish: Anan tells Sisi her family's telephone number.
items.theme: Two classmates share family contact information in the classroom

items.label: Speak different languages
items.sentenceHanzi: 安安说汉语，诺亚说英语。
items.sentencePinyin: An an shuo Han yu, Nuo ya shuo Ying yu.
items.sentenceEnglish: Anan speaks Chinese, and Noah speaks English.
items.theme: Two classmates introduce the languages they speak in the classroom

items.label: Speak multiple languages
items.pinyin: han yu, ying yu, de yu he fa yu
items.sentenceHanzi: 同学们会说不同的语言。
items.sentencePinyin: Tong xue men hui shuo bu tong de yu yan.
items.sentenceEnglish: The classmates can speak different languages.
items.theme: Four classmates share Chinese, English, German, and French language cue cards
